Episode 1 (Original 84) story overview

Spoiler-free overview

Season 4 opens with Mehmed preparing for Rome. A conspiracy along the Ottoman–Akkoyunlu border pulls attention east and places his sons near a developing crisis. For viewers following Sultan Muhammad Fateh with Urdu subtitles, this is the starting point of the season’s new frontier conflict.

Urdu reading summary

چوتھے سیزن کی پہلی قسط میں سلطان محمد روم کی مہم کی تیاری کرتے ہیں، لیکن مشرقی سرحد پر ایک سازش ان کے منصوبے کو خطرے میں ڈال دیتی ہے۔ شہزادہ بایزید اور مصطفیٰ قراسو کے معاملے میں شامل ہوتے ہیں، جبکہ اوزون حسن کی طاقت ایک نئے تصادم کا خدشہ پیدا کرتی ہے۔ یہ خلاصہ قسط کے ابتدائی حالات بیان کرتا ہے، مکمل انجام نہیں۔

Episode numbering help

What happens in Episode 1 (Original 84)?

Spoiler notice: plot details from published synopses.

  1. Rome becomes the next objective

    Mehmed prepares for a western campaign, with Bellini involved in gathering information.

  2. The frontier becomes a pressure point

    A papal scheme targets the Ottoman–Akkoyunlu border, drawing Bayezid and Mustafa toward trouble at Karasu.

  3. An eastern rival comes into view

    Uzun Hasan’s position makes the border crisis a threat to Mehmed’s plans for Rome.

These details come from published synopses, not a complete watched recap. The sources do not establish every scene or the ending.

Episode 1 (Original 84): frequently asked questions

Is Season 4 Episode 1 the same as Episode 84?+

Yes. Season 4 Episode 1 maps to overall Turkish Episode 84, also written Bölüm 84. A dubbed release can use a different cut or numbering.

What is the release date for Episode 84?+

The original Turkish broadcast date is 15 September 2026. That date does not establish when the Urdu-subtitled edition was uploaded.

Where can I watch Episode 84 with Urdu subtitles for free?+

Great Nation is our first choice for free viewing with notifications. Open Episode 1 / Bolum 84 and select Urdu Subtitles. The publisher has verified this release.

How do I choose the correct Urdu version?+

Select Urdu Subtitles beside the Great Nation player. Do not choose Urdu Dubbed when you want the original Turkish episode with translated captions.

What sets up Season 4 in Episode 84?+

The contrast between Mehmed’s plans for Rome and the plot at the eastern frontier. The linked synopses establish this conflict without documenting every scene or the final outcome.
